text:
auditor_elena: Hi all  prepping for SOC2/ISO spot review next week. Need an evidence bundle: all RBAC changes in the last 90 days, one fully-traced example (PR -> approval -> CI -> kube-apiserver audit -> KMS access if applicable), service-account removals (with token revocation or key deletion proof), and the vuln tickets that motivated changes. Can we get a drop by EOD tomorrow?

viv_seceng: We can. Preferred format: rolebinding_changes.csv (pr_id, author, approver, cluster, binding, principals_added, principals_removed, jira_ticket_or_na), a traced_example/ folder, kms_events.csv, service_account_deprov.csv, control_mapping.md, README.txt.

max_oncall: I'll produce the CSV by diffing infra-repo commits and attach PR URLs + approval screenshot. ETA 18:00 local.

sara_infra: For kube audit extraction I'll run this Splunk query and include the raw snippet with ISO8601 timestamps:

```splunk
index=k8s_audit ("RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding") | where _time>=relative_time(now(), "-90d@d") | table _time user verb objectRef.name objectRef.namespace annotations.pr_id requestID
```

sara_infra: KMS usage (AWS) via Athena over CloudTrail parquet:

```sql
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail_parquet WHERE eventName IN ('GenerateDataKey','Encrypt','Decrypt') AND eventTime >= date_add('day', -90, current_date)
```

viv_seceng: Auditor wants a single example where timestamps line up across PR -> CI -> audit -> KMS. Please include PR screenshot showing approver + time. Also timeline.csv with event_time_iso, component, actor, action, evidence_path.

auditor_elena: For SA deprovs include last_active_iso and revocation_event_id or key_deletion_id. And mark any RBAC change driven by a vulnerability with the JIRA id and 1-line remediation.

max_oncall: Noted. I'll flag SEC-5xxx tickets where applicable. Draft bundle will be uploaded to presigned link and emailed to audit mailbox.

artifact-bot: evidence-uploaded evidence-bucket/engsec/4765008888_evidence_bundle.zip (expires in 48h) :package:

viv_seceng: Uploaded bundle contains README.txt listing contacts (viv_seceng primary), rolebinding_changes.csv, traced_example/{pr.png,ci_log.txt,kube_audit_snip.txt,kms_row.csv}, service_account_deprov.csv, control_mapping.md.

auditor_elena: Thanks  i'll download and spot-check tonight. If gaps, i'll ask follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
